place.name: Ruine Puxerloch
place.description: Puxerloch is the local name for a pair of adjacent medieval Höhlenburgen (cave castles) – Burg Luegg and Burg Schallaun, on the Pleschaitz mountain near Teufenbach-Katsch in the Murau district of Styria, Austria. The site lies on the nearly vertical Puxer Wand cliff overlooking the Mur River valley, at roughly 900–950 m above sea level.
